title: SAT Systems of Equations: Everything You Need to Know
description:
Systems of two linear equations are one of the core Algebra skills on the digital SAT. This lesson covers every way they're tested, with six SAT-style practice questions that get harder as you go.

You'll learn:
• Substitution vs elimination, and how to pick in seconds
• The shortcut for "what is x + y?" questions
• How to tell one solution, no solution, or infinitely many just by comparing coefficients
• How to turn a word problem into a system
• How to solve or check any system in Desmos (intersections and sliders)

All practice questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Algebra → Systems of two linear equations in two variables).
